package.author: wmwlwmwl
package.description: 面向开发者和运维人员的轻量全平台 SSH 客户端。

en-US.description: A lightweight, cross-platform SSH client for developers and DevOps.
en-US.longDescription: Lumin is a lightweight, cross-platform SSH client for developers and DevOps. Built on Go native concurrency and a local WebSocket for low-latency terminal sessions, it ships with system resource probes, a remote file manager, command history with smart completion, connection-level proxying, optional encrypted cloud sync, AI chat, and MCP agent integration — no agent installation required on the server.

zh-CN.author: wmwlwmwl
zh-CN.description: 面向开发者和运维人员的轻量全平台 SSH 客户端。
zh-CN.longDescription: Lumin 是一款面向开发者和运维人员的轻量全平台 SSH 客户端。基于 Go 原生并发与本地 WebSocket 提供低延迟终端体验，内置系统资源探针、远程文件管理器、命令历史与智能补全、连接级代理、可选加密云同步、AI 对话与 MCP 智能体集成，无需在服务器端安装 Agent。
zh-CN.name: Lumin
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新日志
（自 v1.3.7 以来）
- chore(deps): bump github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2 from 2.17.0 to 2.17.1
- fix(filemanager): 修复重连目录跳变、慢线路无加载态与 /root 无效探测
- fix(ssh): 整机断线后重连只恢复首个终端
- chore(deps): 同步 package-lock（npm 源切至 npmmirror，babel helper-string-parser 8.0.8）
- fix(terminal): WS 建连时重置 xterm bracketed paste 状态，修复 SSH 重连后粘贴被远端吞字
- chore(deps): bump github.com/pkg/sftp from 1.13.11 to 1.13.12 (#401)
- chore(deps): bump modernc.org/sqlite from 1.60.1 to 1.61.0 (#400)
- chore(deps): bump github.com/labstack/echo/v4 (#399)
- fix: 修复长耗时远端操作超时、SFTP 卡死挂起与文件管理器取消缺失 (#402)
- fix: 文件管理器图标覆盖审计补齐，tar.xz 等压缩包不再落默认图标 (#398)
- fix: 多行门控发送识别 PS2 续行提示符 + 空行保真/误判防护加固 (#397)
- chore(deps): bump github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2 from 2.16.0 to 2.17.0 (#391)
- chore(deps): bump github.com/minio/minio-go/v7 from 7.3.0 to 7.4.1 (#390)
- chore(deps): bump @codemirror/language from 6.12.4 to 6.13.1 in /frontend (#389)
- chore(deps-dev): bump @babel/parser from 8.0.6 to 8.0.7 in /frontend (#388)
- chore(deps-dev): bump vite from 8.3.2 to 8.3.4 in /frontend (#387)
- chore(deps): bump @codemirror/legacy-modes in /frontend (#386)
- chore(deps): bump monaco-editor from 0.56.0 to 0.57.0 in /frontend (#385)
- chore(deps-dev): bump oxlint from 1.86.0 to 1.87.0 in /frontend (#384)
- feat(filemanager): 下载默认保存位置支持目录选择与一键还原
- chore(deps): bump golang.org/x/net from 0.59.0 to 0.61.0 (#381)
- fix(terminal): 粘贴改走 bracketed paste，不再逐行自动执行 (#379)

产物下载
- Linux 便携版 (LumeTerm-1.3.8-linux-amd64)：即下即用
- Linux DEB 安装包 (LumeTerm-1.3.8-linux-amd64.deb)：Debian/Ubuntu 安装包
- Linux RPM 安装包 (LumeTerm-1.3.8-linux-amd64.rpm)：Red Hat/Fedora 安装包
- macOS ARM 版 (LumeTerm-1.3.8-macos-arm64.dmg)：Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)
- macOS Intel 版 (LumeTerm-1.3.8-macos-amd64.dmg)：Intel 芯片
- Windows 便携绿色版 (LumeTerm-1.3.8-windows-amd64-portable.exe)：内嵌 WebView2，即下即用
- Windows 标准安装版 (LumeTerm-1.3.8-windows-amd64-installer.exe)：NSIS 安装包
- 每个产物附带 .sha256 校验文件，自动更新时校验 SHA256 确保文件完整性
- 本 Release 仅 Desktop，Android 端见 LumeTerm-Android
- 许可见仓库 LICENSE

安装/卸载方法

DEB 包（Debian/Ubuntu）
# 安装
sudo dpkg -i LumeTerm-1.3.8-linux-amd64.deb
# 卸载
sudo dpkg -r lumeterm

RPM 包（Red Hat/Fedora）
# 安装
sudo rpm -ivh LumeTerm-1.3.8-linux-amd64.rpm
# 卸载
sudo rpm -e lumeterm
